messages.text: Will it pay for itself?

At home power the sats usually come to less than the electricity — that's not why people buy it. People buy the 40T for the shot at a full block (3.125 BTC, redrawn every ten minutes for years) and to stack sats meanwhile. At 650 W it's about $47 a month at 10¢. What do you pay per kWh?
So it doesn't earn daily?
Ran the power-cost calculator · 12¢/kWh

It earns every day. Pointed at a pool, the 40T pays out small, steady sats straight to your own wallet — daily, no exchange, no KYC. Solo mode instead gives you a shot at a full block. Tell me your rate per kWh and I'll run the monthly sats against your power cost.
What is my daily earnings?

I won't guess sats on you — that number moves with BTC price and difficulty, and I'd rather give you a real one. What I can tell you exactly: 650 W is about 15.6 kWh a day, so roughly 47 cents a day at 10¢ per kWh. Give me your rate and I'll pull today's estimate against it.

At 17.4¢ in (address hidden), the 40T runs 468 kWh a month — about $81 a month, roughly $2.68 a day. I won't put a sats figure next to that until I can quote today's real one.

What the $799 buys you: a draw at a full block every ten minutes, for years, and a real piece of the network running in your house. Is this your first miner?
How much is a full block if I mine it?

A block pays 3.125 BTC, plus the transaction fees in it — that goes to your wallet whole, no split with a pool. In dollars it's whatever BTC trades at that day.

Long odds, I won't pretend otherwise, but the machine draws every ten minutes for years and you still own it after every draw. Want me to set one up?
How much is that in dollars

Depends on the BTC price at that moment — it's 3.125 × spot, so pull up BTC on any price site and multiply by 3.125. At $100k that's $312,500; at $60k it's $187,500.

That's the shot. The steady part is the pool sats, and your power is about $81 a month. Want me to build the cart?
So do I make money only when I solve a block?

Two modes, you choose. Solo is all-or-nothing: nothing until you hit a block, then the whole 3.125 BTC.

Pool mode pays you every day in small amounts for the work your unit does — no block needed. Harlo OS takes a pool URL in settings, so you can switch whenever. Most first-time buyers run pool and flip to solo for fun.
